identity_check: Confirmed as Ironflow AI (www.ironflow.ai; http://ironflow.ai and https://ironflow.ai both 301-redirect to https://www.ironflow.ai/, which serves the site), maker of Flow, 'The AI native ERP for modern manufacturing'. The homepage founder's note is signed 'Andrew Dimitruk, Founder & CEO, Ironflow AI' and says he was COO of Shield AI; the About page lists him as 'CEO, Co-founder' with Jim Carlson as 'President, Co-founder'. The company's own pages give no HQ, founding year or legal entity (footer only '© Ironflow AI'); Shield Capital's portfolio job board lists 'Founded: 2025' and 'Locations: San Diego, CA, USA', and the homepage says 'Built in the USA', so HQ country is recorded as US. Not Ironflow Technologies Inc. (IT / HR software, Dieppe, New Brunswick), IronFlight AI (UAV autonomy) or IronPlate AI: none of them is at the ironflow.ai domain or sells a manufacturing ERP. Category adjacent, layer plant_ops: Flow replaces the ERP itself (demand, MRP and procurement, inventory, production execution, contract flowdowns) for US defense, aerospace, space and energy manufacturers, hosted in AWS GovCloud for ITAR / CUI work; its agents draft supplier emails, attach purchase orders and work MRP exceptions, which touches Utopian Autonomy's procurement wedge, but it is sold as a system of record to a different market rather than as agents on top of a plant's existing ERP. Same call as Aerchain and 1Buy (adjacent / plant_ops); IFS, the incumbent ERP, stays remote. Sector industrial_manufacturing classified from its own words: 'The AI native ERP for modern manufacturing'.

company.name: Ironflow AI
company.description: US startup founded in 2025 by ex-Shield AI COO Andrew Dimitruk, building Flow, an AI-native ERP with agents for planning, procurement, inventory and production, hosted in AWS GovCloud for defense and aerospace manufacturers.

layer_detail: AI-native ERP for discrete manufacturers in defense, aerospace, space, energy and advanced manufacturing. Modules: demand and fulfillment, planning and procurement (MRP and supplier management), inventory across sites with traceability, manufacturing execution (work orders, BOMs, labor, routing, kitting, shop-floor status) and contract intelligence (FAR / DFARS requirements and flowdowns); finance and accounting 'coming soon'. Agents work MRP messages, draft supplier emails with purchase orders attached and monitor replies. Hosted in AWS GovCloud (US) for CUI and ITAR data; the FedRAMP claim is about the hosting environment, not an authorization of Flow itself.
product_summary: Flow, an ERP replacement for defense and aerospace manufacturers in which users state an outcome and AI agents act: planning and MRP, procurement with agent-drafted supplier emails and purchase orders, multi-site inventory, production execution and FAR / DFARS contract flowdowns, hosted in AWS GovCloud for ITAR and CUI data.
